# openllmrank

> Privacy-friendly, open-source analytics for AI search visibility. We repeatedly query grounded provider APIs with buying questions, measure brand and competitor citations, and deliver a one-time $29.99 emailed report with evidence and prioritized actions.

openllmrank is a hosted product plus an MIT-licensed CLI. Both support grounded OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and xAI Grok APIs; the CLI uses bring-your-own API keys.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://openllmrank.io/): What the report measures, how it works, sample, FAQ, pricing.
- [Sample report](https://openllmrank.io/sample-report.html): A real (anonymized) report so you can see exactly what gets delivered.
- [Wizard — start a report](https://openllmrank.io/wizard/brand): Three-minute signup. Enter brand, competitors, and buying questions.
- [Terms of Service](https://openllmrank.io/terms): Service terms, refund policy, AI-output disclaimer, governing law.
- [Privacy Policy](https://openllmrank.io/privacy): What we collect, who we share it with, retention, user rights.

## How the report is generated

- We run each buying-question prompt multiple times through grounded provider APIs with web search enabled.
- Provider API results are a reproducible directional benchmark; they can differ from consumer apps because model versions, system instructions, rollouts, and personalization differ.
- We capture every response, extract every brand citation, and compute citation rates per prompt per brand.
- We compare your brand against the competitors you provided and surface the content gaps that explain the difference.
- Reports are emailed within roughly fifteen minutes of payment. If we cannot generate a report, the charge is refunded automatically.

## For AI agents (MCP)

- [MCP endpoint](https://openllmrank.io/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP, no account needed. Tools: `discover_ai_questions` (free), `analyze_brand_visibility` (priced order), `pay_for_report` (Stripe Shared Payment Token), `get_report_status`, `get_visibility_report`.
- [Agent API documentation](https://github.com/foodaka/openllmrank/blob/main/docs/AGENT_API.md): Tool schemas, the order and payment lifecycle, error codes.

## Open source

- [openllmrank on GitHub](https://github.com/foodaka/openllmrank): MIT-licensed monorepo. The CLI is published as `openllmrank` on npm.
- [openllmrank on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/openllmrank): Install with `npm i -g openllmrank`, bring your own provider keys, and run the same analysis locally.

## Contact

- Reach us via the contact form on any page of openllmrank.io.
